panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Shows 1 while a recent OTLP process metric exists; 0 when the application is unavailable.

panels.title: Telemetry age
panels.description: Age in seconds of the latest OTLP process metric sample. This replaces the Prometheus-only scrape duration metric.

panels.title: Application ready time
panels.description: Time from process start until the application is ready.

panels.title: Application started time
panels.description: Time from process start until the application context has started.

panels.title: 95th percentile response time
panels.description: Requires management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram.http.server.requests=true.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))) or 1000 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))))

panels.title: 99th percentile response time
panels.description: Requires management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram.http.server.requests=true.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))) or 1000 * histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))))

panels.title: HTTP availability
panels.description: Availability based on the presence of the application OTLP process metric.

panels.title: Responses under 250 ms
panels.description: Fraction of HTTP responses completed within 250 ms. Requires request histograms.

panels.title: Server error rate
panels.description: Fraction of HTTP responses with a 5xx status in the selected time range.

panels.title: Total HTTP requests
panels.description: Total HTTP requests observed in the selected time range.

panels.title: HTTP requests by route and status
panels.description: Current request rate grouped by URI, method, status, and outcome. The table is intentionally high cardinality and is for drill-down use.

panels.title: HTTP errors by status
panels.description: 4xx and 5xx response rates grouped by status and outcome.

panels.title: Login outcomes
panels.description: Successful and failed local, social, and OAuth client authentication attempts.

panels.title: Token grants by type
panels.description: Access, ID, and refresh token issuance grouped by OAuth grant type.

panels.title: Logout outcomes
panels.description: OIDC logout completions, including upstream provider logout redirects.

panels.title: OAuth errors by code
panels.description: OAuth protocol errors grouped by bounded error code and grant type.

panels.title: Token activity by client
panels.description: Token activity by registered client; no user or token identifiers are exported.

panels.title: Heap memory: used, committed, max
panels.description: Heap memory used, committed, and maximum values.

panels.title: GC overhead
panels.description: GC CPU overhead reported by the native runtime. Detailed pause count, maximum pause, and cause metrics are not exposed by GraalVM Native Image.

panels.title: Database connection timeouts
panels.description: Rate of database connection acquisition timeouts.

panels.title: Database connection acquisition
panels.description: Connection waiters, acquisition rate, and average acquisition wait. Supports OTLP milliseconds and Prometheus seconds names.

targets.expr: ((sum by (instance) (rate(hikaricp_connections_acquire_milliseconds_sum{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (rate(hikaricp_connections_acquire_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])), 1)) or 1000 * (sum by (instance) (rate(hikaricp_connections_acquire_seconds_sum{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance) (rate(hikaricp_connections_acquire_seconds_count{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])), 1)))

panels.title: Active instances
panels.description: Number of application instances currently publishing process uptime.

panels.title: Request rate by instance
panels.description: Request rate for each application instance or Kubernetes pod target.

panels.title: Heap memory by instance
panels.description: Heap memory used, committed, and maximum values by instance or Kubernetes pod target.

panels.title: Database connections by instance
panels.description: Active and pending database connections per application instance.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Percentage of cache lookups served from the Caffeine cache during the selected window.

panels.title: Cache reads by result
panels.description: Cache hit and miss rates for application caches.

panels.title: Cache evictions and size
panels.description: Eviction rate and current entries across application caches.

panels.title: Cache activity by cache
panels.description: Per-cache read hit/miss, writes, removals, evictions, and current size. Missing optional cache instruments simply return no rows.

panels.title: HTTP latency distribution
panels.description: Response-time bucket distribution from the native Prometheus seconds histogram. Percentile panels above provide the same view as summary values.

panels.title: Database pool utilization
panels.description: Active and idle Hikari connections as a percentage of the configured maximum pool size.
